name: mba-studio
description: Plataforma de membresias y reservaciones para MBA MID (Studio de Pilates y Academia de Ballet/Danza).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/admin
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/web --if-present && npm run test --workspace apps/admin --if-present
